questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns you about an upcoming curve in the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road will curve right first, then curve left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic go first before entering the intersection or road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is posted at traffic lights to tell you that you cannot turn right when the light is red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Should maintain your vehicle’s speed until you enter the reduced speed zone.
Should begin to reduce your vehicle’s speed.
Should not slow down because traffic will start to back up.
May reduce your speed, if you choose to do so.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should begin to reduce your vehicle’s speed.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to start slowing down. The new speed limit will be shown on the next speed limit sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should drive with the flow of traffic.
Limit your speed for the next 50 miles.
Speed limits are enforced for the next 50 miles.
The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum speed you are legally allowed to drive in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you are not allowed to turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is posted where you should not go, usually at the end of one-way streets. Stop and turn around if you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you are not allowed to turn left at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means this lane will exit the freeway. You cannot stay in this lane to continue through the interchange. You must either change lanes to go through or stay in this lane to exit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: On vertical traffic signals, red is on top and green is on the bottom. On horizontal signals, red is on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the overpass ahead is low. Do not drive under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: A stop sign is eight-sided. You must come to a complete stop and look both ways for pedestrians and traffic. Do not move until the intersection is clear.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the road ahead will curve right and then left. Slow down to safely drive through these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers to wait for the left turn signal before turning left. You may only turn left when the signal indicates it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will make a sharp turn to the right and then a sharp turn to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in this direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there’s a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always give pedestrians the right of way in crosswalks. Pay attention when you approach intersections or turn to avoid hitting pedestrians.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road. You should drive slower than the limit in bad weather or poor road conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It is yellow with black markings and diamond-shaped. It tells drivers that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. It shows a red circle with a red slash through it. This means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that pedestrians may be crossing ahead. Watch for people entering or crossing your path. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign with yellow background and black markings. It alerts drivers to watch for pedestrians crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that drivers must obey. It shows you can either turn right or continue driving straight from this lane at the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is an eight-sided sign. It tells drivers to come to a complete stop and give the right-of-way to others. You may proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a three-sided sign. It tells drivers to slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Give the right-of-way to other drivers and pedestrians. You may proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that you must obey. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is an orange construction sign. It warns drivers that workers may be on or near the road. Drive carefully and be extra cautious in construction zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign with yellow background and black markings. It alerts drivers that a stop sign is coming up ahead. Prepare to stop completely before proceeding.
